$comment: Provider pack: markitdown MCP (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX -> Markdown) — upstream markitdown-mcp from PyPI (#487), stdio by default, MARKITDOWN_ENABLE_PLUGINS=false kept in the server env. Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack markitdown (v2 shape: mcp.servers.<name>.disabled:false + permissions array rule). --enable-pack markitdown also installs the runtime declared in the install block below (generic install_pack_runtime). Appends the permissions rule {"action": "markitdown*", "resource": "*", "effect": "allow"} to flip the shipped deny.
$install-notes: Why the exact pin: upstream publishes only alpha releases (0.0.1a1-0.0.1a7); plain `pip install markitdown-mcp` fails (pip skips pre-releases), so an exact pre-release pin installs without --pre. Why the mcp[cli] co-install: docling-mcp>=3.0 requires mcp[cli]>=2.0,<3.0 and markitdown-mcp requires mcp>=2.1.1,<3.0.0 — installing both specs in one resolve keeps the shared MCP SDK at 2.x for both servers. Bump ritual: bump the pin here (packages + idempotent.version) — this block is the only pin carrier (#677; formerly deploy/setup.sh).
